limitations: Repeated fixed 510-task monitoring is not independent held-out model selection.
Map and SFT reference histories, numbering, supervision and updated parameters differ.
Different physical actions and success sets do not identify internal mechanisms.
Common-success path lengths are conditional on both policies succeeding.
The content probe is a stratified 32-task exploratory sample with correlated within-task states.
Reverse Q-content dependence is not matched-training evidence of incremental benefit over no map.

training_route_audit.scope: 8000 ordinary successful map training demonstrations; excludes initial-goal and masked failure contexts
limitations: Manifest census covers all 8000 trajectories; cached replay and fresh exact solving cover a stratified sample of 64.
Filtering existing shortest demonstrations is not new physical-route augmentation.
Data length differences alone do not identify their causal effect on task success.
